sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Our time to hire for engineering roles is now about two months.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Candidates drop out between the third and fourth interview.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Do we really need four rounds?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We cut the process to three interviews and merge the two technical rounds.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good, I've wanted that for a while.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: We keep losing candidates between rounds three and four.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And it now takes roughly two months to hire an engineer.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then we go to three interviews by combining the two technical ones.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Agreed.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's decide on the learning budget.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Only {PERCENT} of the budget was used last year.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: People say they don't have time, not that they don't want it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We keep the budget and add two learning days per person per year.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: That should help.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Last year people used just {PERCENT} of the learning budget.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: They say it's about time, not interest.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So the budget stays the same, plus two dedicated learning days each per year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The office survey results are in.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Most people come in two days a week, and almost nobody comes on Fridays.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We're paying for desks nobody uses.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Sorry, {S2}, could you repeat that?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We give up the second floor when the lease renews and move to shared desks.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Makes sense.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Agreed.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: According to the survey, people come in twice a week on average, and Fridays are empty.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So a lot of desks sit unused.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: At the lease renewal we drop the second floor and switch to shared desks.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Sorry, {S1}, could you repeat that?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good call.
